name: Raw Binary Snapshot Upload
description: When armed and motion is detected, POST a raw JPEG snapshot directly to an evidence archive endpoint. Uses snapshot_upload (raw binary Content-Type: image/jpeg transfer), unlike http_request with attach_snapshot which base64-encodes the image inside JSON. Demonstrates the snapshot_upload action, per-rule lifetime max_executions cap, and Authorization header injection.
